title: Share a stable sibling workflow
why: Sibling overrides repeating an ordered workflow duplicate invariant behavior.
suggestion: Consider a shared workflow with one varying step.
limitations: Requires sibling overrides with four to ten calls and exactly one differing call; analyzer execution hooks named `analyze` and AST visitor hooks named `visit...` are excluded.
Comments, strings, generated, test, example, and vendored sources follow normal analysis classification and suppression controls.
